tickets.title: Compare HELOC reset payment against refinance and payoff alternatives
tickets.text: Compare the projected Silver Marmot Credit Union home equity line reset payment for Evan and Lena Cloudpuddle against three alternatives: a full mortgage refinance, a fixed home equity loan, and an accelerated payoff. Use the lender terms Evan brought to the meeting, the existing $86,400 outstanding balance, the $498,000 first mortgage at Teacup Comet Bank, and the $715,000 county home valuation.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up due 2024-09-06 is to compare the projected home equity line reset payment with refinance, fixed home equity loan, and accelerated payoff alternatives
